title: When the Archive Wakes
author: Tamsin Villalobos
blurb: Zephyrine Yarrow, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
